title: Forward-only lint repair of the constitutional validator after #367

why5.question: Why are the ci and governance checks on main 83323774 failing?
why5.answer: The push-event `npm run gate` for the #367 merge diffed protected paths without any changed delivery/constitutional-cases docket, so inspectConstitutionalChange reported 'CONSTITUTION: exactly one changed human approval case docket required'.

why5.question: Why is a forward-only governance PR required instead of repairing #367 or relaxing the gate?
why5.answer: Historical check runs are bound to their own BASE_SHA/HEAD_SHA and cannot be re-satisfied retroactively; ruleset 23969502 requires four checks with no bypass, so the only lawful path is a new PR whose own diff carries a complete docket.

why5.question: Why does the validator file itself need to change?
why5.answer: `eslint .` (CI step `npm run check:lint`) reports three no-unused-vars errors in it: RE_SHA256 (line 20), sha (line 25) and the destructured parameter trustPublicKeyB64 (line 108). CI would still fail after the gate step even with a valid docket.
why5.evidence_ref: local: git show 83323774:harness/scripts/validate-constitutional-change.mjs | npx eslint --stdin -> 3 errors, EXIT=1 (gov-post367/01-eslint-base.log)

why5.question: Why is the repair semantics-neutral?
why5.answer: The two removed constants had zero references; trustPublicKeyB64 was destructured but never read (Ed25519 attestation is deferred pre-Phase4). Callers may still pass the property, which is ignored exactly as before. A base-vs-candidate differential run over 25 fixtures x 3 key variants produced identical results (0 mismatches) and testConstitutionFailClosed returns 15 for both.

why5.question: Why must this be a separate governance-only PR with a docket, not part of #365?
why5.answer: harness/ is a constitution-protected governance_only_path, which requires exactly one exact-candidate docket; Sprint is HOLD (active_sprint=null), so validate-change-scope rejects any implementation-root path (src/, tests/, supabase/, package-lock.json) that #365 carries. Mixing them would fail the scope gate and widen the approval surface.
why5.evidence_ref: harness/scripts/validate-change-scope.mjs lines 317-320; harness/scripts/validate-constitutional-change.mjs lines 36-39 and 115-121; delivery/CURRENT-SPRINT.json at 83323774

negative_tests: testConstitutionFailClosed (run by governance-gate): 15 PASS on base and candidate

differential fixtures: protected change without docket, two dockets, invalid JSON, case id/path mismatch, base SHA mismatch, protocol mismatch, exact-path mismatch, duplicate paths, byte drift, why5 count/evidence, approval missing/null/AI source/wrong decision/wrong scope/blank ref/digest mismatch/zero time/case mismatch all still fail closed with identical errors
rollback: Revert the merge commit of this PR (git revert <merge-sha>) through a new governance PR carrying its own GOV docket; no data, schema, product or lifecycle state is affected.
